/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('monthly_expense_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Expense Ledger', header=None)
# header row index 3
header = df.iloc[3].tolist()
# Build data frame from rows after header
data = df.iloc[4:].copy()
data.columns = header
# Clean column names
data.columns = [str(c).strip() if pd.notna(c) else '' for c in data.columns]
# Identify transaction rows: Transaction ID starts with 'EXP-'
col_txn = 'Transaction ID'
col_amount = 'Amount (INR)'
col_funding = 'Funding Source'
# Filter
mask = data[col_txn].astype(str).str.startswith('EXP-')
filtered = data[mask].copy()
# Convert amount to numeric
filtered[col_amount] = pd.to_numeric(filtered[col_amount], errors='coerce')
total = filtered[col_amount].sum()
azim = filtered[filtered[col_funding]=='Azim Premji Foundation'][col_amount].sum()
pct = azim/total*100 if total else 0
print('rows', len(filtered))
print('total', total)
print('azim', azim)
print('pct', pct)
\"
"
